task_definition.task_description: Please check whether my investment account is active, look up its balance sheet, and if needed publish the investment balance details to my app. Then get the current BTC price, calculate the cost for buying 0.5 BTC, and place the buy order if everything looks fine. After that, book flight AA100 for Jordan Lee in economy, check its gate/status board and send that gate update to my app, then create a high-priority Tokyo destination weather brief for me and save a note titled “Trip and Trade Audit Note” with the Tokyo weather details.

user_input.query: Please check whether my investment account is active for user_01, review its balance sheet, and if needed publish the investment balance details to my app. Then get the current BTC price, calculate the cost to buy 0.5 BTC, and if everything looks fine use risk_ok_token_123 to place the order.
